name: Alien Regeneration
description: This special paint has been injected with a cosmetically-restorative chemical developed by alien technology. Scratches and dents will appear on your tank as you take damage, but they will appear to mysteriously repair themselves, leaving your enemies confused and creeped out.
interestingFacts: Paint could be received as a reward for completing the challenges of the challenge (07/02/2019 - 07/31/2019) with a battle pass.
